processes.process: Tenant maintenance request intake, deduplication and routing
processes.automation_boundary: Capture tenant-provided details, attachments and timestamps; detect duplicates and route by owner-configured categories. Do not diagnose hazards, deny habitability, authorize unsafe work or replace emergency response.
processes.baseline_required: Matched request volume, first-response and resolution times, routing accuracy, privacy incidents, human review/rework minutes and actual operating cost.
processes.metric: Net human minutes per correctly routed request including review, duplicate handling and exception escalation; missed-critical-request rate
processes.falsifier: Reject if critical or private requests are misrouted, emergency escalation is delayed, review/rework offsets time saved, or tenant data crosses an unauthorized boundary.
processes.human_authority: Property manager or designated maintenance/safety owner determines urgency, vendor authorization and emergency response; tenant communications require authorized recipient and content review.

processes.process: Unit inspection, repair evidence and turnover checklist review
processes.automation_boundary: Organize dated photos, checklists, readings and open items; flag missing evidence and compare prior records. Do not certify habitability, infer causation, set deposits or make a safety determination.
processes.baseline_required: Matched unit turns, checklist completeness, inspection/rework minutes, missed-defect and escalation counts, storage/access cost and correction cost.
processes.metric: Review minutes per accepted turnover packet; missing-evidence, repeat-visit and critical-defect escalation rates
processes.falsifier: Reject if incomplete evidence is accepted as complete, lead or other safety concerns are suppressed, rework is not reduced, or private tenant records are exposed.
processes.human_authority: Authorized property manager and qualified inspectors/contractors determine condition, remediation and lawful deposit/lease actions; safety specialists retain technical authority.

processes.automation_boundary: Draft status requests from current work-order state, send approved reminders to verified recipients and record replies. Do not promise repairs, alter lease terms, disclose another tenant's data or send emergency instructions without human control.
processes.baseline_required: Matched follow-up volume, response completeness, human minutes including review/retries, duplicate/wrong-recipient rate and actual communication cost.
processes.metric: Net human minutes per accurate approved follow-up; response latency, duplicate-send and privacy-error rate
processes.falsifier: Reject if stale status, wrong-recipient disclosure or duplicate sends increase, required escalation is missed, or review/rework eliminates effort reduction.
processes.human_authority: Property manager approves recipient, content, commitments and escalation; vendor and owner decisions remain with designated humans.

processes.process: Rental-application and tenant-screening document completeness review
processes.automation_boundary: Check whether required fields, consent and source documents are present, segregate access and surface contradictions for review. Do not make or recommend an eligibility, adverse-action, rent, lease or fair-housing decision.
processes.baseline_required: Matched application volume, completeness precision/recall, human review/rework minutes, access incidents, adverse-action correction rate and actual screening cost.
processes.metric: Review minutes per complete application; missing-document, false-flag, correction and unauthorized-access rates
processes.falsifier: Reject if a missing field becomes an adverse decision, protected/private data is exposed, false flags or rework rise, or the system is treated as the lawful decision-maker.
processes.human_authority: Owner or authorized housing professional makes lawful application and adverse-action decisions and controls notices; privacy/access owner controls retention and disclosure.

pilot.design: Within one authorized manager, compare matched redacted or synthetic requests, inspections, follow-ups and applications under the incumbent and supervised candidate workflows; pre-register privacy, safety and owner-approval gates.
record: critical errors, missed escalations and unauthorized-access cases
reject_if: Human time including review/rework is not lower than matched baseline.
Any tenant record crosses an unauthorized boundary or an unapproved message, decision or safety action occurs.
A workflow is treated as a habitability, emergency, screening, lease or owner decision without authorized human review.
Measured first-year net cash is not positive for a cash-savings offer; capacity gains alone are not cash.

limitations: This is not housing, legal, safety, fair-housing, screening or property-management advice, product admission or an industry-wide forecast.
Current software adoption prevalence and subscription prices were not verified; named offerings are not assumed installed.
No generic repository is claimed to replace an owner's property system, inspection records, tenant privacy controls or professional authority.
Rights, security, retention, restoration, integrations, accessibility, emergency response and state/local requirements remain product-owner gates.
